title: World Advanced Daisenryaku: Koutetsu no Senpuu
native_title: ワールド・アドバンスド 大戦略 ～鋼鉄の戦風～
overview:
With the wish that this tragedy will never be repeated.

In Campaign Mode, you can choose your nation from Germany, America, and Japan.

About 500 kinds of weapons that really existed, realistically recreated.

A turn-based World War II strategy game. Command land, sea and air units on hex maps through historical battles such as Pearl Harbor, Midway, Stalingrad and Normandy. Win convincingly and the war can take a different course, leading to hypothetical operations that never happened. Choose Standard or Campaign mode, and watch each clash play out in battle scenes.

- For 1 to 5 players
- Shuttle Mouse compatible
- Memory backup support

この悲劇が二度と繰り返されないことを願って

キャンペーンモードでは、ドイツ・アメリカ・日本から自国の選択が可能。

約500種類の実在した兵器をリアルに再現。
